messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Warm-up periode
parts:
On Fri, 29 May 2020 at 21:34, Krocki26412 <a.i.a-c...@t-online.de> wrote:
>
> how can I determine the warm-up period in my data?

There is no single magic recipe for this I'm afraid. For steady-state
simulations, there are a number of post-processing algorithms in the
literature to decide a cutting point for a long enough simulation. See
[1] for more details and references. For non steady-state simulations,
I don't think there's any general way to determine that.

[1] https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer/issues/214#issuecomment-549136080

--
Iñaki Úcar
